notes.title: Department Bulletin: New Summary Report, Linux Support and bug fixes!
notes.content:
[p]Attention all detectives, rookies, and Linux enjoyers.[/p][p][/p][p]📊 [b]A[/b] [b]new summary now appears at the end of the game[/b]. This new screen appears just before the credits, and shows how many clues you were able to collect and displays the various subplots and dramas you uncovered while solving the main investigation. 

[b]Note: For save files from before version 1.0.52, the subplot information on the stats screen may be incomplete.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]🐧 [b]We are also introducing native Linux support![/b] Following our last week release of [b]Mac OS support[/b], we aim to welcome detectives from all operating systems.[/p][p][/p][p]🧪 Additionally, we have:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue of the FPS limiter not applying in some instances[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a clock that was tracking time twice in the museum[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues with the map view not showing the hover information correctly[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]If you find any bugs or have any feedback, please share it in the active discussion post.[/p][p][/p][p]– Metro City PD  [i]Serving justice with half a clue and a quarter of lung capacity since 1999.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Nabos Studios Team [/p][p]Over and out, agents of mayhem 🕵️[/p]

notes.title: Department Bulletin: Mac OS Support is Out. Metro City Just Got a New Playground
notes.content:
[p]Attention all Mac detectives, rookies, and professional procrastinators

Metro City is now open on Mac OS! That means you can now interrogate, investigate, and spirally question your sanity right from your shiny Apple devices.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Grab your badge and dive into the mystery with frutiger aero style. Don't worry—Jason's sarcastic commentary sounds just as good on Mac speakers.[/p][p][/p][p]– Metro City PD 
[i]Serving justice with half a clue and a quarter of lung capacity since 1999.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Nabos Studios Team [/p][p]Over and out, agents of mayhem 🕵️[/p]

notes.title: Department Bulletin: Demo’s Out. Your First Taste of Metro City Awaits.
notes.content: [p]Detectives, recruits, and vaguely interested bystanders,[/p][p][/p][p][b]We have a freshly launched Free Demo![/b] Dip your toes into the shady streets of Metro City, meet its charmingly unhelpful citizens, and get acquainted with our brand of absurdity.[/p][p][/p][p][b]💼 In the demo, you’ll get:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Your first chunk of the case [/p][/*][*][p]A questionable introduction to Jason's case-solving skills [/p][/*][*][p]Enough sarcasm to season an entire precinct’s lunch [/p][/*][*][p]Just enough mystery to make you suspicious of your neighbor’s cat[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]If you haven’t tried it yet. There’s no excuse now. [b]Grab the demo, test the vibe, and let us know if you make it out with your sanity intact.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]– Metro City PD [i]Serving justice with half a clue and a quarter of lung capacity since 1999.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Nabos Studios Team [/p][p]Over and out, agents of mayhem 🕵️[/p]

notes.title: Department Bulletin: Gamepad’s In. Metro City in Your Hands.
notes.content:
[p]Detectives, rookies, and professional couch potatoes… We’ve upgraded your crime-solving toolkit.[/p][p]
🎮 [b]Gamepad support is here.[/b] Jason can now be controlled with slightly more comfort and style. Who says law enforcement can’t have ergonomic posture?[/p][p]
🧪 We’ve also rolled up our sleeves and: [/p][list][*][p]Fixed a few bugs (the digital kind) [/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted some colliders in various levels [/p][/*][*][p]Restored a few missing lines [/p][/*][*][p]Polished up some visuals across the game[/p][/*][*][p]Added some QOL[/p][/*][*][p]Increased overall stability (Emotionally? No. Technically? Yes.) [/p][/*][*][p]Squashed some sneaky crashes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]So whether you’re a keyboard crusader or a joystick detective, Metro City is now yours to navigate however you like.[/p][p][/p][p]And if you’ve already solved the case: Know that your feedback and chaos are keeping this city alive, detective![/p][p][/p][p]– Metro City PD [i]Serving justice with half a clue and a quarter of lung capacity since 1999.
[/i][/p][p]Nabos Studios Team 
Over and out, agents of mayhem 🕵️[/p]

notes.title: Department Bulletin posted above the coffee maker
notes.content:
[p]Hello, detectives and curious onlookers. [/p][p] [/p][p]First things first: [i]thank you.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]To every strange soul who bought the game, solved the case, or just wandered around Metro City with a strange craving for [i]a piece of cozy autumn[/i]. You’ve combed clues, interrogated weirdos, and probably questioned your own sanity.
[/p][p]Welcome to the force. You’re the reason the coffee machine still runs. (Sort of.)
[/p][p]We’ve recently discovered the World Wide Web is not just for conspiracy forums.
We're now "on the socials":
[/p][p]🐾 Follow our TikTok for moving pictures of maniacs[/p][p]👀 Spy our Instagram for photographic evidence[/p][p]💾 Drop into our YouTube interrogation tapes [/p][p]👂 Listen (read?) Detective Maxx complains about life on Twitter (or whatever it's called now)
[/p][p][b]Case files can be found on all platforms...
[/b][/p][p]🧪In development at the labs:[/p][list][*][p]A [b]Demo[/b], so more freaks can walk these streets for free.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gamepad support[/b], so your thumbs can suffer too.[/p][/*][*][p]Aaaand [b]Spanish localization[/b], because Metro City is international in its dysfunction.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]More updates coming soon.[/p][p]Until then… watch your back, your neighbor, and definitely that plant.[/p][p]
[/p][p]– Metro City PD
[i]Serving justice with half a clue and a quarter of lung capacity since 1999.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Nabos Studios Team[/p][p]Over and out, weirdos 👀[/p][p]
